purpose: One small longer-time development screen of unchanged smooth-6-12 hybrid versus shipped HCE after exactly 50 percent fixed-node play; not a formal strength test.
schedule: Lowest 20 salted-SHA256 opening indices in digest order; white then black for even original indices, black then white for odd indices.

warmup.indexMeaning: Slots 0..3 in selected opening list, not original global opening IDs

scoreAnalysisRequires: Complete 40-game inventory and41 archived members; independently replayed histories, endpoints, termination, raw requests and stop reasons.
statistics: Descriptive score and one-sided 95 percent t-approx lower bound over 20 paired-opening means. This exposed subset differs from prior 200-game populations; cross-study score changes are not causal evidence.
termination: Engine gameStatus rules including full-prefix repetition history, otherwise draw at 180 searched plies; no evaluator-score adjudication.
budgetJustification: 200 ms is ten times the prior 20 ms development budget and still below Master’s five seconds. Forty games cap requested search time at 24 minutes plus warmup/capture overhead; 35-minute hard watchdog. No expansion after results.

decisionRule.promisingNext: Discuss whether development evidence justifies another changed runtime candidate; this protocol authorizes no additional run and no production change.
decisionRule.otherwiseNext: Inspect captured move-ranking and phase failures before new optimization or training; this protocol authorizes no additional run.
decisionRule.interpretation: Research routing only. Forty games and 20 exposed pairs are too small for shipping or generalization; do not infer causal budget benefit by comparing populations.

timingInterpretation: Sequential single-game execution only after the exclusive qsearch benchmark ends. Preserve observed elapsed per move and report overruns; elapsed is not remeasured by replay. No Master-strength or runtime-admission claim.

openingSelection.algorithm: SHA256 UTF8(salt + "|" + decimal(originalIndex)), ascending hex digest; first 20

precursor.route: promising/runtime under frozen >=0.5 rule; conditional failure sampler skipped
